items.ar: باب فِي أَنَّهُ إِذَا قِيلَ فِي الرَّجُلِ شَيْ‏ءٌ فَلَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ وَ كَانَ فِي وَلَدِهِ أَوْ وَلَدِ وَلَدِهِ فَإِنَّهُ هُوَ الَّذِي قِيلَ فِيهِ

items.en: Chapter 128 – The Imams<sup>asws</sup>, all of them<sup>asws</sup> are establishing the Command of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Exalted, guiding to Him<sup>azwj</sup>
items.ar: باب أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ ( عليهم السلام ) كُلَّهُمْ قَائِمُونَ بِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى هَادُونَ إِلَيْهِ

items.en: Chapter 129 – Helping the Imam<sup>asws</sup>
Chapter 13  The Imams<sup>asws</sup> are the Light (نُورُ ) of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ ( عليهم السلام ) نُورُ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ

items.en: Chapter 130 – Al-Fey (Military gains) and Al-Anfal (Non-military gains) and the interpretation of Al-Khums (A fifth of military gains) and its limits and what it is Obligated upon
items.ar: باب الْفَيْ‏ءِ وَ الْأَنْفَالِ وَ تَفْسِيرِ الْخُمُسِ وَ حُدُودِهِ وَ مَا يَجِبُ فِيهِ

items.en: Chapter 14 – The Imams<sup>asws</sup>, they<sup>asws</sup> are the Stabiliers of the earth
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ هُمْ أَرْكَانُ الْأَرْضِ

items.en: Chapter 15 – Miscellaneous - Summarisation of the merits of the Imam<sup>asws</sup> and his<sup>asws</sup> description
items.ar: باب  نَادِرٌ جَامِعٌ فِي فَضْلِ الْإِمَامِ وَ صِفَاتِهِ

items.en: Chapter 16 – The Imams<sup>asws</sup> are the Masters of the Command (Wali Al-Amr), and they<sup>asws</sup> are the envied people whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic has Mentioned
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ ( عليهم السلام ) وُلَاةُ الْأَمْرِ وَ هُمُ النَّاسُ الْمَحْسُودُونَ الَّذِينَ ذَكَرَهُمُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ

items.en: Chapter 17 – The Imams<sup>asws</sup>, they<sup>asws</sup> are the Signs which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Mentioned in His<sup>azwj</sup> Book
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ ( عليهم السلام ) هُمُ الْعَلَامَاتُ الَّتِي ذَكَرَهَا اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فِي كِتَابِهِ

items.en: Chapter 18 – The Signs which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Mentioned in His<sup>azwj</sup> Book, they<sup>asws</sup> are the Imams<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْآيَاتِ الَّتِي ذَكَرَهَا اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فِي كِتَابِهِ هُمُ الْأَئِمَّةُ ( عليهم السلام )

items.en: Chapter 19 – Whatever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic and His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup> Necessitated from the creation, is with the Imams<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ مَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ رَسُولُهُ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مِنَ الْكَوْنِ مَعَ الْأَئِمَّةِ ( عليهم السلام )

items.en: Chapter 2 – The categories of the Prophets<sup>asws</sup>, and the Rasools<sup>as</sup>, and the Imams<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ طَبَقَاتِ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ وَ الرُّسُلِ وَ الْأَئِمَّةِ ( عليهم السلام )

items.en: Chapter 20 – The Ahl Al-Zikr (The People of the Reminder) for whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Commanded the people to be asking them<sup>asws</sup>, they<sup>asws</sup> are the Imams<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ أَهْلَ الذِّكْرِ الَّذِينَ أَمَرَ اللَّهُ الْخَلْقَ بِسُؤَالِهِمْ هُمُ الْأَئِمَّةُ ( عليهم السلام )

items.en: Chapter 21 – The ones whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Described as being with the knowledge, they<sup>asws</sup> are the Imams<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ مَنْ وَصَفَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى فِي كِتَابِهِ بِالْعِلْمِ هُمُ الْأَئِمَّةُ ( عليهم السلام )

items.en: Chapter 22 – The Ones firmly rooted in knowledge, they<sup>asws</sup> are The Imams<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الرَّاسِخِينَ فِي الْعِلْمِ هُمُ الْأَئِمَّةُ ( عليهم السلام )

items.en: Chapter 23 – The Imams<sup>asws</sup> have been Given the Knowledge and Affirmed into their<sup>asws</sup> chests
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ قَدْ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ وَ أُثْبِتَ فِي صُدُورِهِمْ

items.en: Chapter 24 – Regarding that the ones whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Chose from His<sup>azwj</sup> servants and Made them to inherit His<sup>azwj</sup> Book, they<sup>asws</sup> are the Imams<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: باب  فِي أَنَّ مَنِ اصْطَفَاهُ اللَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ وَ أَوْرَثَهُمْ كِتَابَهُ هُمُ الْأَئِمَّةُ ( عليهم السلام )

items.en: Chapter 25 – The Imams in the Book of Allah<sup>asws</sup> are two (types of) Imams – an Imam<sup>asws</sup> calling to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and an imam calling to the Fire
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ إِمَامَانِ إِمَامٌ يَدْعُو إِلَى اللَّهِ وَ إِمَامٌ يَدْعُو إِلَى النَّارِ

items.en: Chapter 26 – The Quran Guides to the Imams<sup>asws</sup>
Chapter 27 – The Favour (النِّعْمَةَ) which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Mentioned in His<sup>azwj</sup> Book, are the Imams<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ النِّعْمَةَ الَّتِي ذَكَرَهَا اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فِي كِتَابِهِ الْأَئِمَّةُ ( عليهم السلام )

items.en: Chapter 28 – The Distinguishers whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Exalted Mentioned in His<sup>azwj</sup> Book are the Imams<sup>asws</sup> and the straight way among them
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ الَّذِينَ ذَكَرَهُمُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى فِي كِتَابِهِ هُمُ الْأَئِمَّةُ ( عليهم السلام ) وَ السَّبِيلُ فِيهِمْ مُقِيمٌ

items.en: Chapter 29 – The deeds are presented to the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> and the Imams<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ عَرْضِ الْأَعْمَالِ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) وَ الْأَئِمَّةِ ( عليهم السلام )

items.en: Chapter 3 – The difference between the Rasool<sup>as</sup>, and the Prophet<sup>as</sup>, and the Muhaddith
items.ar: بَابُ الْفَرْقِ بَيْنَ الرَّسُولِ وَ النَّبِيِّ وَ الْمُحَدَّثِ

items.en: Chapter 30 – The doctrine which it is urged to be steadfast upon is Wilayah of Ali<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الطَّرِيقَةَ الَّتِي حُثَّ عَلَى الِاسْتِقَامَةِ عَلَيْهَا وَلَايَةُ عَلِيٍّ ( عليه السلام ) .

items.en: Chapter 31 – The Imams<sup>asws</sup> are a Mine of Knowledge, and a tree of the Prophet-hood, and interchage of the Angels (where Angels come and go)
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ ( عليهم السلام ) مَعْدِنُ الْعِلْمِ وَ شَجَرَةُ النُّبُوَّةِ وَ مُخْتَلَفُ الْمَلَائِكَةِ

items.en: Chapter 32 – The Imams<sup>asws</sup> are the inheritors of the Knowledge, inheriting the Knowledge from each other
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ ( عليهم السلام ) وَرَثَةُ الْعِلْمِ يَرِثُ بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضاً الْعِلْمَ

items.en: Chapter 33 – The Imams<sup>asws</sup> inherited the Knowledge of the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> and of the entirety of the Prophets<sup>as</sup> and the successors<sup>as</sup> who were from before them<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ وَرِثُوا عِلْمَ النَّبِيِّ وَ جَمِيعِ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ وَ الْأَوْصِيَاءِ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ

items.en: Chapter 34 – The Imams<sup>asws</sup>, with them<sup>asws</sup> are the entirety of the Books which were Revealed from Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic, and they<sup>asws</sup> recognise these upon their different languages
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ ( عليهم السلام ) عِنْدَهُمْ جَمِيعُ الْكُتُبِ الَّتِي نَزَلَتْ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ أَنَّهُمْ يَعْرِفُونَهَا عَلَى اخْتِلَافِ أَلْسِنَتِهَا

items.en: Chapter 35 – No one collected the Quran, all of it, except for the Imams<sup>asws</sup>, and they<sup>asws</sup> are knowing its Knowledge, all of it
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَجْمَعِ الْقُرْآنَ كُلَّهُ إِلَّا الْأَئِمَّةُ ( عليهم السلام ) وَ أَنَّهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَهُ كُلَّهُ

items.en: Chapter 36 – What has been Given to the Imams<sup>asws</sup> from the Magnificent Name of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ مَا أُعْطِيَ الْأَئِمَّةُ ( عليهم السلام ) مِنِ اسْمِ اللَّهِ الْأَعْظَمِ

items.en: Chapter 37 – What is with the Imams<sup>asws</sup> from the Signs of the Prophets<sup>as</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ مَا عِنْدَ الْأَئِمَّةِ مِنْ آيَاتِ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ ( عليهم السلام )

items.en: Chapter 38 – What is with the Imams<sup>asws</sup> from the weapons of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> and his<sup>saww</sup> chattels
items.ar: بَابُ مَا عِنْدَ الْأَئِمَّةِ مِنْ سِلَاحِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) وَ مَتَاعِهِ

items.en: Chapter 39 – An example of the weapons of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> is an example of the Ark among the Children of Israel
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ مَثَلَ سِلَاحِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) مَثَلُ التَّابُوتِ فِي بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ

items.en: Chapter 4 – The Divine Authority cannot be established for Allah<sup>azwj</sup> upon His<sup>azwj</sup> creatures except by an Imam<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْحُجَّةَ لَا تَقُومُ لِلَّهِ عَلَى خَلْقِهِ إِلَّا بِإِمَامٍ

items.en: Chapter 40 – In it is the mention of the Parchment, and the Jaf’r, and the Jami’e, and Parchments of Fatima<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: باب فِيهِ ذِكْرُ الصَّحِيفَةِ وَ الْجَفْرِ وَ الْجَامِعَةِ وَ مُصْحَفِ فَاطِمَةَ ( عليها السلام )

items.en: Chapter 41 – Regarding the glory of [97:1] We have indeed revealed this in the Night of Predestination (Chapter 97) and its interpretation
items.ar: باب فِي شَأْنِ إِنَّا أَنْزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ وَ تَفْسِيرِهَا

items.en: Chapter 42 – Regarding that the Imams<sup>asws</sup> are being increased (with knowledge) during the night of Friday
items.ar: باب فِي أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ ( عليهم السلام ) يَزْدَادُونَ فِي لَيْلَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ

items.en: Chapter 43 – If the Imams<sup>asws</sup> were not to be increased, it would deplete what is with them<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ لَوْ لَا أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ ( عليهم السلام ) يَزْدَادُونَ لَنَفِدَ مَا عِنْدَهُمْ

items.en: Chapter 44 – The Imams<sup>asws</sup> are knowing the entirety of the knowledges which came out to the Angels, and the Prophets<sup>as</sup> and the Rasools<sup>as</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ ( عليهم السلام ) يَعْلَمُونَ جَمِيعَ الْعُلُومِ الَّتِي خَرَجَتْ إِلَى الْمَلَائِكَةِ وَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ وَ الرُّسُلِ ( عليهم السلام )

items.en: Chapter 45 – In it is the Mention of the Unseen
Chapter 46 – The Imams<sup>asws</sup>, whenever they<sup>asws</sup> desire to know (something), they<sup>asws</sup> know (it)
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ ( عليهم السلام ) إِذَا شَاءُوا أَنْ يَعْلَمُوا عُلِّمُوا

items.en: Chapter 47 – The Imams<sup>asws</sup> are knowing when they<sup>asws</sup> would be passing away, and they<sup>asws</sup> are not passing away except by a choice from them<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ ( عليهم السلام ) يَعْلَمُونَ مَتَى يَمُوتُونَ وَ أَنَّهُمْ لَا يَمُوتُونَ إِلَّا بِاخْتِيَارٍ مِنْهُمْ

items.en: Chapter 48 – The Imams<sup>asws</sup> know the knowledge of whatever has happened, and whatever will be happening, and it is so that nothing is hidden from them<sup>asws</sup>, may the Salawat of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> be upon them<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ ( عليهم السلام ) يَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ مَا كَانَ وَ مَا يَكُونُ وَ أَنَّهُ لَا يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِمُ الشَّيْ‏ءُ صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ

items.en: Chapter 49 – Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic did not Teach His<sup>azwj</sup> Prophet<sup>saww</sup> a knowledge except that He<sup>azwj</sup> Commanded him<sup>asws</sup> that he<sup>saww</sup> teach it to Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup> was his<sup>saww</sup> associate in the knowledge
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَمْ يُعَلِّمْ نَبِيَّهُ عِلْماً إِلَّا أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُعَلِّمَهُ أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ شَرِيكَهُ فِي الْعِلْمِ

items.en: Chapter 5 – The earth cannot be empty from a Divine Authority
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْأَرْضَ لَا تَخْلُو مِنْ حُجَّةٍ

items.en: Chapter 50 – Aspects of the knowledges of the Imams<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ جِهَاتِ عُلُومِ الْأَئِمَّةِ ( عليهم السلام )

items.en: Chapter 51- The Imams<sup>asws</sup>, if secrets would have been kept, they<sup>asws</sup> would have informed every person with whatever was for him and against him
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ ( عليهم السلام ) لَوْ سُتِرَ عَلَيْهِمْ لَأَخْبَرُوا كُلَّ امْرِئٍ بِمَا لَهُ وَ عَلَيْهِ

items.en: Chapter 52 – The Authorising to Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> and to the Imams<sup>asws</sup> regarding the command of the Religion
items.ar: بَابُ التَّفْوِيضِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) وَ إِلَى الْأَئِمَّةِ ( عليهم السلام ) فِي أَمْرِ الدِّينِ

items.en: Chapter 53 – Regarding that the Imams<sup>asws</sup> are resembling with the ones from the past and the abhorrence of the speech regarding them<sup>asws</sup> being with the Prophet-hood
items.ar: باب فِي أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ بِمَنْ يُشْبِهُونَ مِمَّنْ مَضَى وَ كَرَاهِيَةِ الْقَوْلِ فِيهِمْ بِالنُّبُوَّةِ

items.en: Chapter 54 – The Imams<sup>asws</sup> are Muhaddisoun (ones discussing with the Angels), understaning ones
items.ar: بَابُ أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ ( عليهم السلام ) مُحَدَّثُونَ مُفَهَّمُونَ

items.en: Chapter 55 – Regarding the mention of the spirits within the Imams<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: باب فِيهِ ذِكْرُ الْأَرْوَاحِ الَّتِي فِي الْأَئِمَّةِ ( عليهم السلام )

items.en: Chapter 56 – The spirit by which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Protects the Imams<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ الرُّوحِ الَّتِي يُسَدِّدُ اللَّهُ بِهَا الْأَئِمَّةَ ( عليهم السلام )

items.en: Chapter 57 – The time when the Imam<sup>asws</sup> learns the entirety of the knowledge of the Imam<sup>asws</sup> who was before him<sup>asws</sup>
items.ar: بَابُ وَقْتِ مَا يَعْلَمُ الْإِمَامُ جَمِيعَ عِلْمِ الْإِمَامِ الَّذِي كَانَ قَبْلَهُ ( عليه السلام )

items.en: Chapter 58 – The Imams<sup>asws</sup> are equal regarding the knowledge, and the bravery, and the (Obligated) obedience
items.ar: باب فِي أَنَّ الْأَئِمَّةَ صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِمْ فِي الْعِلْمِ وَ الشَّجَاعَةِ وَ الطَّاعَةِ سَوَاءٌ
